dictations.preRound: Temp 38.1 last night, runny nose and a dry cough, likely viral. Lungs clear. She is on levothyroxine. Walked 150 feet with the walker today. Staples are out, incision clean. Pain 3 out of 10 on acetaminophen.

Interval Changes Since Last Visit

Resident admitted for rehabilitation following left hip fracture repair. Ambulation has progressed to 150 feet with walker. Surgical incision is clean with staples removed. Pain is controlled at 3 out of 10 on acetaminophen. Resident developed fever 38.1°C last night with runny nose and dry cough, consistent with likely viral illness. Lungs are clear on examination.

Current Vitals and Weight Trend

Temperature 38.1°C recorded last night. Current weight not dictated today.

Functional Status Update

Resident ambulating 150 feet with walker. Eating well. Fatigued but tolerating activity.

Active Medical Problems

Left hip fracture status post repair: Incision clean, staples removed, pain controlled at 3 out of 10 on acetaminophen. Ambulation progressing with walker.

Likely viral illness: Fever 38.1°C, runny nose, dry cough. Lungs clear. Resident fatigued but eating well.

Hypothyroidism: On levothyroxine.

Medication Changes

No medication changes made today.

Assessment and Plan

Left hip fracture status post repair: Resident progressing well with ambulation and pain control. Incision healing appropriately. Continue current pain management with acetaminophen. Continue physical therapy as tolerated.

Likely viral illness: Resident with fever, upper respiratory symptoms, and fatigue. Lungs clear, no respiratory distress. Encourage increased fluid intake. Recheck temperature this evening. Monitor for worsening symptoms or respiratory changes.

Hypothyroidism: Continue levothyroxine.
